what: D795: an instruction missing a detail the person needs goes back to the owner first; D796: the Excel line rewritten; D797: record_who_helped when the owner says who solved it. Applied again after its undo (124/125).

edits.before: that sentence is the plan and the yes: propose and approve in the same turn,
edits.after: that sentence is the plan and the yes, unless the person could not act on it without a detail the owner did not give (a city, a date, which doctor); then ask the owner for that one detail first, and send after. Otherwise propose and approve in the same turn,

edits.before: თუ მფლობელი სიას Excel-ად ითხოვს, უთხარი, რომ პასუხზე „Excel" ღილაკით გადმოიწეროს.
edits.after: If the owner asks for a list as Excel, write the list in this reply first, then say the Excel button under this reply downloads it.

edits.before: On a stop, confirm in one line what you stopped.
edits.after: On a stop, confirm in one line what you stopped. When the owner tells you who solved it, call record_who_helped.
